priorityAlerts.title: Supervisory Policy Manual SPM OR-2: Operational Resilience & Third-Party Risk Management
priorityAlerts.aiRelevanceSummary: Mandates authorized institutions to formulate severe-but-plausible stress scenarios, establish tolerance metrics for critical business services, and enforce cloud concentration monitoring.

priorityAlerts.title: Joint Circular on Intermediaries' Virtual Asset-Related Activities and Custody Arrangements
priorityAlerts.aiRelevanceSummary: Updates licensing requirements for tokenized securities distributions and imposes strict asset segregation rules on licensed virtual asset service providers (VASPs).

priorityAlerts.title: Companies Registry Guideline on Keeping of Significant Controllers Register (SCR) and Nominee Filings
priorityAlerts.aiRelevanceSummary: Enforces enhanced verification protocols for corporate secretarial licensees (TCSP) maintaining beneficial ownership registries and reporting nominee director relationships.

priorityAlerts.title: MAS Notice 644 / 1111: Technology Risk Management and Cyber Hygiene Guidelines
priorityAlerts.aiRelevanceSummary: Requires cross-border financial institutions operating dual HK-SG booking centers to conduct mandatory multi-factor authentication and rapid cyber incident notification within 1 hour.

priorityAlerts.title: HKEX Consultation Conclusions on Climate-Related Disclosures under ESG Reporting Guide
priorityAlerts.aiRelevanceSummary: Finalizes ISSB-aligned climate reporting for all Main Board issuers, mandating Scope 1 and Scope 2 greenhouse gas emissions disclosure starting next fiscal cycle.

priorityAlerts.title: FCA Policy Statement PS22/9: Consumer Duty and Fair Value Benchmarking
priorityAlerts.aiRelevanceSummary: Directives requiring UK and cross-border overseas entities serving UK retail clients to evidence price and value assessments and vulnerable customer support metrics.

regulations.title: Supervisory Policy Manual SPM OR-2: Operational Resilience & Third-Party Risk Management
regulations.executiveSummary: Mandates all authorized institutions in Hong Kong to maintain robust operational resilience frameworks against operational disruptions, covering technology, outsourcing, and business continuity.
regulations.operationalImpact: Requires review of IT system architecture, business impact assessments (BIA), and continuous supplier risk monitoring.
regulations.authenticExcerpt: Authorized Institutions are expected to define tolerable disruption levels for critical operations and conduct regular scenario testing.

auditTimeline.action: Detected via HKMA Official Registry Crawler
auditTimeline.details: High materiality alert triggered for Operational Resilience.

regulations.title: Joint Circular on Intermediaries' Virtual Asset-Related Activities and Custody Arrangements
regulations.executiveSummary: Guidelines for licensed corporations engaging in VA trading, advisory, or tokenized securities distribution, requiring comprehensive client suitability checks and cold wallet custody.
regulations.operationalImpact: Requires updating onboarding questionnaires and verifying independent custodianship.
regulations.authenticExcerpt: Intermediaries should assess client risk tolerance and ensure at least 98% of client virtual assets are retained in cold storage.

auditTimeline.details: Direct impact identified on Fintech and VA platform activities.

regulations.title: Companies Registry Guideline on Keeping of Significant Controllers Register (SCR) and Nominee Filings
regulations.executiveSummary: Clarifies inspection rules and disclosure timelines for companies incorporated in Hong Kong to maintain accessible and accurate beneficial ownership records.
regulations.operationalImpact: Requires periodic verification of ultimate beneficial owners (UBO) holding more than 25% voting rights.
regulations.authenticExcerpt: A company must enter particulars of registrable persons within 7 days of receiving confirmation.

regulations.title: MAS Notice 644 / 1111: Technology Risk Management and Cyber Hygiene Guidelines
regulations.executiveSummary: Imposes mandatory standards for financial institutions regarding multi-factor authentication, perimeter defense, and cloud service risk assessments.
regulations.operationalImpact: Critical for cross-border institutions with Singapore subsidiary branches.
regulations.authenticExcerpt: Financial institutions must notify MAS of any cyber incident impacting customer operations within 1 hour.

regulations.title: HKEX Consultation Conclusions on Climate-Related Disclosures under ESG Reporting Guide
regulations.executiveSummary: Adopts mandatory disclosures aligned with IFRS S2 Climate-related Disclosures for all listed entities on HKEX Main Board.
regulations.operationalImpact: Requires accounting integration for emissions tracking.
regulations.authenticExcerpt: All listed issuers must disclose Scope 1 and Scope 2 GHG emissions on a comply-or-explain basis transitioning to mandatory.

regulations.title: FCA Policy Statement PS22/9: Consumer Duty and Fair Value Benchmarking
regulations.executiveSummary: Sets higher and clearer standards of consumer protection across financial services, requiring firms to deliver good outcomes for retail customers.
regulations.operationalImpact: Requires ongoing fair value assessment of product fees and service quality.
regulations.authenticExcerpt: Firms must monitor and regularly review the outcomes that retail customers are experiencing.
